title: 13 Best Herbal Teas For Burns
intro: Herbal teas for Burns are a natural and alternative remedy used to soothe and treat burns, which are defined as damage to the skin or underlying tissues caused by heat, cold, or chemicals. These teas have been found to have numerous benefits in treating burns, including reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and easing pain. Examples of herbal teas used to treat burns include Aloe Vera tea, which is rich in vitamins and minerals that promote skin regeneration; Marshmallow root tea, which has anti-inflammatory properties that help reduce redness and swelling; Chamomile tea, which has antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties that aid in wound healing; and Calendula tea, which is known for its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties that prevent infection and promote tissue repair. Additionally, other herbal teas such as Lavender tea, Peppermint tea, and Ginger tea have also been used to treat burns due to their anti-inflammatory and soothing properties.
